evidence_role: separate raw-source follow-up with development-selected fixed spectral control and paired confirmation
historical_results: The earlier 24 method runs remain a separate campaign. They are neither restarted nor pooled with these results.

dataset.name: AudioCaps V1
dataset.source: raw original encoded WAV archive; official pinned train/valid/test memberships and original captions
dataset.selection: All eligible official source members after fixed duration, finite-decode, cross-split canonical-audio and YouTube-ID exclusions; no outcome-dependent selection.
dataset.all_zero_audio: retained and reported; zero PCM groups do not trigger duplicate exclusion
dataset.readiness: data/DATA_READY.json plus full manifest and audit hashes; counts are determined by this fixed audit, never historical mirror counts
dataset.prior_exposure: This dataset has been studied previously. This study does not claim an unseen test benchmark.
dataset.pretraining: Frozen AST AudioSet pretraining can include underlying AudioCaps recordings. No untouched-pretraining claim.

features.canonicalization: unchanged retained load_audio_16k: soundfile float32 always_2d, arithmetic mean channels, scipy.signal.resample_poly to 16000 Hz, float32; no amplitude adjustment
features.pooling: drop two special tokens; adaptive average pool patch sequence to 64 tokens
features.cache_layout: resumable numpy memmap, immutable committed batch records
features.cache_binding: full manifest ordered rows, raw-source readiness binding, exact model files, preprocessing, reference/code hashes and runtime; never path/count-only
features.duplicate_audit: hash exact canonical first-window input including its shape; reject cross-split nonzero equal inputs
features.test_features: frozen AST extraction only; no caption-model/test outcome during tuning

architecture.trainable: 2-layer AudioTokenEncoder, 8-query learned prefix with cross-attention, GPT-2 decoder
architecture.loss: retained pooled next-token cross entropy plus retained rank-16 spectral DCR on prefix and pooled audio encoder features
architecture.objective_interpretation: spectral representation regularization; no supervised aligned classification-ratio objective claim

initialization.rule: construct one complete CPU model per seed, save immutable initial.pt and RNG after construction; every method strictly loads that same binary and asserts its full state tensor hash
initialization.historical_discrepancy: The cause of the historical initial-state mismatch is unknown. The reference positional parameter uses torch.zeros followed by nn.init.trunc_normal_; it is not uninitialized.

optimization.last_batch: drop final incomplete batch each epoch; deterministic fresh per-epoch permutation
optimization.paired_randomness: same immutable seed initial state, deterministic epoch data order, per-step reset CPU/CUDA dropout stream, same optimizer budget
optimization.resume: model, optimizer, complete controller/monitor/action/pending reward state, CPU/CUDA/Python/numpy RNG and data-order RNG, bound to INPUT_BINDING and resolved job configuration

split_routing.controller_feedback: first 64 lexicographically sorted official-valid IDs; all original five references
split_routing.development: remaining valid IDs; no gradient updates
split_routing.test: all retained official-test IDs, confirmation final checkpoints only
split_routing.no_test_tuning: No test caption decoding or test NLL during tuning. Final tuning development CIDEr-D is the only selection score.

tuning.selection: highest arithmetic mean final-step development CIDEr-D across the three seeds; exact tie selects smaller lambda
tuning.selection_metric: historical pycocoevalcap CIDEr-D with Java PTB tokenizer only
tuning.freeze: SELECTED_FIXED.json before any confirmation training; all 18 outcomes retained
tuning.interpretation: tuned fixed is an added control selection procedure, not a changed spectral algorithm

spectral_control.full_macc_configuration: literal audio-side engine.configure historical dictionary in train_study.py
spectral_control.terminal_credit: compile unchanged historical TerminalSafeLoop class AST only; reward final pending action, never draw an unused next action; no historical engine/diffusion import

evaluation.metric_assets: exact historical metric_vendor copy, SHA-256 bound; frozen local Java 8; no fallback or asset downloads
evaluation.nll: target-token-weighted pooled next-token NLL, test and development, final confirmation only
evaluation.conditioning_diagnostic: deterministic cyclic mismatching of development audio and original captions; no gradient and no favorable-result gate
evaluation.saved_outputs: every candidate plus all five original references, token-loss batches, controller trajectory, summary, final float32 state, full resume checkpoint
evaluation.audit: fresh child process strict final-state reload and bitwise full-logit/NLL development probe; saved-caption metric recomputation, reference and token-weighting checks before DONE

statistics.primary_inference: two-sided exact enumeration of all 1024 sign flips including ties; Holm across the five prespecified contrasts at familywise alpha 0.05
statistics.sensitivity_inference: two-sided paired Student t with a separate five-contrast Holm adjustment; sensitivity only, never an alternative success criterion
statistics.multiplicity: primary family: five exact sign-flip p-values; separate sensitivity family: five paired-t p-values; no success rule based on either family being significant
statistics.intervals: individual unadjusted 95% paired t confidence intervals, not simultaneous
statistics.secondary: all other metrics and conditioning diagnostics descriptive only
statistics.incomplete_or_nonfinite: stop; no dropped seed, replacement seed or partial inferential table
statistics.assumptions: paired t: independent seed pairs with approximately normal paired differences; sign flips: sign exchangeability/symmetry under the null

execution.environment: Python 3.12; torch 2.6.0+cu124; transformers 5.15.1; exact assets frozen separately
execution.feature_process: logical GPU 0 only; exits before task workers
execution.gpu_mapping: coordinator sets each child's CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; runner --gpu 0 is logical index
execution.sharding: finite unchanged deterministic list, confirmation method order rotated by seed; job_index modulo 1; one worker executes all 18 tuning and 40 confirmation jobs sequentially on physical GPU 0; own fcntl worker and per-job child locks
execution.job_isolation: training subprocess then separate clean-audit subprocess; GPU memory released between them
execution.smoke: two real train clips, two optimizer steps, matched initial assertion, finite nonzero caption/spectral gradients, exact interruption/resume check, two validation-only real-model generations with no quality gate, fixed synthetic-text PTB/CIDEr-D/BLEU/ROUGE-L/METEOR/SPICE/SPIDEr runtime fixture, Full-MACC terminal fixture; zero scientific runs and no test outcomes
